description: breast sentinel node, macrometastasis with extranodal extension more than 2 mm, one of two nodes
report:
Lymph nodes, left SLN1, sentinel lymph node biopsy

Received in formalin is a piece of fibroadipose tissue containing two lymph nodes. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Lymph nodes 1-2.

Sections show fibroadipose tissue and two lymph nodes. One of the lymph nodes is involved by metastatic carcinoma, the largest deposit measuring 6 mm (macrometastasis). Extranodal extension is present, extending more than 2 mm beyond the lymph node capsule. The tumour cells are highlighted by immunostain for pancytokeratin AE1/AE3. The remaining one lymph node is reactive.

LYMPH NODES, left SLN1, sentinel lymph node biopsy - METASTATIC CARCINOMA (1/2); largest deposit 6 mm (macrometastasis); extranodal extension present (more than 2 mm)
